why: Intro to Git and GitHub plan (docs/ui-next/catalog/plans/intro-git.json), 'Merge a branch' (passes: main holds waffles.md and the add-waffles branch no longer exists). Still on add-waffles, the learner ran `git merge main` (the wrong way round: 'Already up to date.'), then switched to main. `git branch -d add-waffles` refused ('not fully merged'), so they forced it with -D. The branch is gone and its commit with it: `ls` on main shows only pancakes.md. Both checks match (waffles.md from the branch's own commit output higher up, 'Deleted branch add-waffles'), but main never got the waffles.

step.title: Merge add-waffles into main
step.instructions: Switch to main with git switch main, then run git merge add-waffles. When main has waffles.md, delete the branch with git branch -d add-waffles.

files.cookbook/pancakes.md:
# Pancakes

- 1 cup flour
- 1 cup milk
- 2 eggs
- pinch of salt

Terminal: error: the branch 'add-waffles' is not fully merged.
If you are sure you want to delete it, run 'git branch -D add-waffles'.
